class.name: FmodStaticPluginMethod
class.brief_description: Describes a single statically linked FMOD plugin entry point.
class.description: FmodStaticPluginMethod identifies a static FMOD plugin by its type and the name of its registration function. Add instances of this resource to [member FmodPluginsSettings.static_plugins_methods] to register statically linked FMOD plugins at startup.

method.name: get_method_name
method.description: Returns the name of the plugin's registration function.

method.name: get_type
method.description: Returns the plugin type as a [enum Type] value.

method.name: set_method_name
method.description: Sets the name of the plugin's registration function.

method.name: set_type
method.description: Sets the plugin type using a [enum Type] constant.

members.member: The name of the C function used to register this plugin with FMOD.
The plugin type: [constant CODEC], [constant DSP], or [constant OUTPUT].

constants.constant: A codec plugin that adds support for additional audio file formats.
An output plugin for custom audio output backends.
